title: Would You Open the Door? (Zombie Outbreak, Day 12)

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Day 12 of the zombie outbreak. You're locked inside a gas station... and someone knocks.
lines.tts: [tense, low] Day twelve of the zombie outbreak. You're locked inside a gas station... and someone knocks.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Every highway gas station has a night window: a steel drawer for passing cigarettes to customers after midnight.
lines.tts: [measured] Every highway gas station has a night window. A steel drawer, for passing cigarettes to customers after midnight.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: The knock comes again. You crawl to the window, and you slide the drawer open one inch.
lines.tts: [whispering] The knock comes again. You crawl to the window... and you slide the drawer open... one inch.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Tonight, a voice comes through it. A woman. Trucker jacket. Hands up. 'Please. I'm not bitten.'
lines.tts: [tense] Tonight, a voice comes through it. A woman. Trucker jacket. Hands up. [desperate whisper] Please. I'm not bitten.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Her name is Dee. Her truck jackknifed a mile down the highway. And she has news.
lines.tts: [calm] Her name is Dee. Her truck jackknifed a mile down the highway. And she has news.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: The radio says the National Guard will run an evacuation point at the county stadium. Eighteen days from now. Six miles away.
lines.tts: [hopeful, careful] The radio says the National Guard will run an evacuation point at the county stadium. Eighteen days from now. Six miles away.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Problem four isn't zombies. It's people. Open the door, and you get a partner... or someone who takes everything you have.
lines.tts: [serious, tense] Problem four isn't zombies. It's people. Open the door, and you get a partner... or someone who takes everything you have.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: What would you do? Think about it. Because you don't open the door.
lines.tts: [low, direct] What would you do? [pause] Think about it. Because you don't open the door.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: You slide two bottles of water through the drawer instead. She nods... and walks back into the rain.
lines.tts: [soft] You slide two bottles of water through the drawer instead. She nods... and walks back into the rain.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: A pickup truck rolls in. Three men. Empty gas cans. And in the passenger seat... Dee.
lines.tts: [low] A pickup truck rolls in. Three men. Empty gas cans. And in the passenger seat... [pause] Dee.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: They pound on the shutter. 'Open up, and nobody gets hurt.'
lines.tts: [tense] They pound on the shutter. [shouting, distant] Open up, and nobody gets hurt!

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Was Dee their prisoner... or their guide? Would you have opened the door? All thirty days are on my channel.
lines.tts: [low, intrigued] Was Dee their prisoner... or their guide? Would you have opened the door? [softer] All thirty days are on my channel.
